messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Code working in local but not in shinyapps.io
parts:
In that case, my guess is that this is a difference in your local Windows versus shinyapps.io which is Linux.
You do not appear to be encoding the URL you are requesting, and I would guess that whatever is handling fetching the URL on Windows does that transparently, but on Linux it is passed without modification to curl.
